testimonials.quote: Jeff connected four ERPs to our sales floor in a quarter. Our finance team stopped re-keying orders overnight.
He thinks like a founder and ships like a team of five. Rent reconciliation went from days to seconds.
The rare engineer who can sit with the CFO in the morning and debug the integration by lunch.

overview: Asira TMS is a trucking management system for East African haulage companies. It replaces the spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups, and paper delivery notes that most fleets still run on with one system for loads, trucks, drivers, and money.

Dispatchers plan loads and routes, drivers confirm pickups and deliveries from their phones, and the back office invoices customers and pays drivers from the same record — so every shilling can be traced to a trip.
I designed and built the platform end to end: the data model, the dispatch board, invoicing, driver settlements, and the reporting that tells an owner which trucks and routes actually make money.

features.title: Load planning
features.description: Build loads from customer orders, assign trucks by capacity, and see the week's plan on one board.

features.title: Routing & dispatch
features.description: Route trips, dispatch drivers, and follow every truck from pickup to proof of delivery.

features.title: Invoicing
features.description: Turn delivered trips into customer invoices automatically, with rates per route and customer.

features.title: Driver payments
features.description: Settle driver allowances and trip pay against the trips they actually completed.

features.title: Revenue tracking
features.description: Profit per truck, per route, and per customer, so owners can see what earns and what burns.

features.title: Reporting
features.description: Daily operations and monthly finance reports, exportable for accountants and lenders.

items: Designed the data model connecting loads, trips, trucks, drivers, and invoices
Set up the platform, authentication, roles, and multi-company tenancy
Built the dispatch board and trip lifecycle from planning to proof of delivery
Built driver settlements and allowance tracking
Built automated invoicing from delivered trips
Built profitability reporting per truck, route, and customer

echokey.shortDescription: Voice-first AI assistant for Windows — talk to your computer, dictate anywhere, and run actions across your apps with a hotkey.
overview: EchoKey is a voice-first AI layer for Windows. Hold a key, speak, and it types, edits, searches, or runs an action in whatever app has focus — no copy-pasting into a chat window.
It pairs fast speech recognition with a language model that understands context: the document you are in, the text you selected, and the commands you use most.
I built the desktop client, the hotkey and audio pipeline, and the command system that turns a sentence into an action.

features.title: Push-to-talk anywhere
features.description: One global hotkey dictates into any Windows app.

features.title: Context-aware edits
features.description: Select text and say what to change — rewrite, shorten, translate.

features.title: Voice actions
features.description: Open apps, search, and run workflows by voice.

features.title: Custom commands
features.description: Teach EchoKey your own phrases and macros.

items: Built the Windows client, tray app, and global hotkey handling
Built the audio capture and streaming speech pipeline
Built the command parser that maps speech to actions
Built context capture from the focused app and selection

auctioneers.shortDescription: Online auction platform for licensed auctioneers — catalogues, live bidding, deposits, and buyer verification.
overview: A web platform that moves licensed auctioneers' sales online: listings with photos and documents, timed and live bidding, buyer registration, and deposits.
It had to be trustworthy enough for high-value assets — vehicles, property, and equipment — so verification, audit trails, and clear bid history were first-class features.
I built the bidding engine, the listing management back office, and the buyer flows end to end.

features.title: Catalogues
features.description: Lots with photos, documents, reserve prices, and viewing schedules.

features.title: Live & timed bidding
features.description: Real-time bids with anti-sniping extensions and a full bid history.

features.title: Buyer verification
features.description: Registration, ID checks, and refundable deposits before bidding.

features.title: Auctioneer back office
features.description: Manage sales, lots, buyers, and settlements in one place.

items: Built the real-time bidding engine with anti-sniping rules
Built listings, catalogues, and the auctioneer back office
Built registration, verification, and deposit flows
Built bid history and outbid notifications

peperuka.shortDescription: Multi-vendor marketplace connecting local vendors to buyers — storefronts, orders, payouts, and delivery.
overview: Peperuka is a multi-vendor marketplace that gives small local vendors an online storefront without building one themselves.
Vendors list products and manage orders; buyers shop across many vendors in one cart; the platform splits payments and coordinates delivery.
I built the marketplace core: vendor onboarding, catalogues, the multi-vendor cart and checkout, and vendor payouts.

features.description: Every vendor gets a branded store with their own catalogue.

features.title: Multi-vendor cart
features.description: One checkout across many vendors, with split payments.

features.title: Payouts
features.description: Automatic vendor payouts net of commission.

features.title: Delivery
features.description: Order tracking from vendor to doorstep.

items: Built vendor onboarding, storefronts, and catalogue management
Built the multi-vendor cart, checkout, and split payments

nahla-naturals.shortDescription: E-commerce store for a natural skincare brand — fast storefront, editable catalogue, and checkout.
overview: Nahla Naturals is a natural skincare brand that needed a storefront as considered as its products.
I built a fast Next.js store with a Sanity CMS so the team can edit products, stories, and campaigns themselves, plus checkout and order notifications.
The result is a site that loads instantly on mobile data and that the brand can run without a developer.

features.description: Statically generated product pages that load instantly.

features.title: Editable catalogue
features.description: Products, stories, and campaigns edited in Sanity.

features.title: Checkout
features.description: Cart, checkout, and order notifications.

items: Built the Next.js storefront and Sanity content model
